script_text: Stop, Pisces — your home is about to make some serious noise. The Gemini Full Moon is conjunct shocking Uranus in your 4th House of home and family, opposing the Sun in your 10th House of career. And your ruling planet, Neptune, is trining Mercury in your 2nd House of money. Single Pisces, as a water sign, you'll feel a magnetic pull toward someone unconventional, so follow that ripple. Taken Pisces, expect a sudden revelation from your partner, so listen without defending. Mercury, direct since November 13th, is conjunct the Sun in Sagittarius, firing up your 10th House, so pitch that bold idea to your boss while Saturn in Aries supports you. Avoid confronting family over old wounds tonight. Follow for tomorrow's reading — this week, Pisces, is not finished with you.
